title: New department name reflects KU School of Engineering’s growing strength in energy
summary_en: The University of Kansas Department of Chemical & Petroleum Engineering has been renamed the Department of Chemical & Energy Engineering. The department’s two degree programs — chemical engineering and petroleum engineering — will remain unchanged.
title_cn: New department name reflects KU School of Engineering’s growing strength in energy

title: KU College of Liberal Arts & Sciences announces Department of Earth, Energy & Environment
summary_en: KU's new academic department will combine the departments of  Geography & Atmospheric Science and Geology and the Environmental Studies Program. The merger aims to strengthen collaboration while preserving each program’s identity and degree requirements.
title_cn: KU College of Liberal Arts & Sciences announces Department of Earth, Energy & Environment

title: Grocery returns lead to greater customer engagement and increase in sales, research finds
summary_en: In new research, Kissan Joseph, Crown/Sherr Professor at the University of Kansas School of Business, finds that following a product return at a grocery store, customer engagement rises significantly, driving a 40.1% increase in subsequent sales.
title_cn: Grocery returns lead to greater customer engagement and increase in sales, research finds
